title: kCombatLog
description: This is a combat log plugin, it has support for placeholder api and is very configurable.
body:
### **kCombatLog**

kCombatLog is a plugin made for you to punish those annoying players who just decide to quit in the middle of pvp. The timer is totally configurable, the core features are toggleable.

## **Roadmap:**

- Prevent players from using pearls while in combat.
- Prevent players from using elytra while in combat.
- Make it so you can choose which mobs actually put the player in combat.
